start: A new gym member with no routines, on the Workout tab showing the card 'Make your first routine'

steps.action: Tap the card 'Make your first routine'
user_sees: Step 1 'Name your folder', hint 'A folder keeps your routines together, like a plan for your week.'
Folder name 'My plan' filled in
Button 'Next' and 'Skip' in the top bar
must_not: An empty folder name that still lets 'Next' through

steps.action: Tap 'Next', tap a ready name such as 'Push Day'
user_sees: Step 2 'Name your routine', hint 'A routine is the list of exercises for one day. Tap a name or type your own.'
must_not: 'Next' enabled with an empty or spaces-only name

steps.action: Tap 'Next', tick three exercises
user_sees: Step 3 'Pick your exercises', hint 'Tap each exercise you want to do. You can change them later.'
Ticked exercises marked
must_not: An exercise ticked twice in the list

steps.action: Tap 'Next', then 'Save routine'
user_sees: Step 4 'Check and save' ('Each exercise starts with <n> sets...')
Busy button, then back on the Workout tab with the 'My plan' folder open and the routine in it
must_not: Two folders or two routines from a double tap
The card 'Make your first routine' still shown after saving

start: A gym member with a routine, on the Workout tab

steps.action: Tap the routine
user_sees: Preview screen 'Routine': each exercise with sets x reps, rest, superset and note; facts line '<day> · <n> exercises · <folder>'
Buttons 'Edit routine' and 'Start routine'
must_not: Editing controls on the preview
A start with zero exercises (Start is greyed out then)

steps.action: Tap 'Start routine'
user_sees: The live workout with the routine's exercises and sets
must_not: Two workouts opened by a double tap

steps.action: Start a routine while another workout is open
user_sees: Pop-up 'A workout is already open' with Resume or 'Discard and start new'
must_not: The open workout dropped without asking

steps.action: Tap 'Add exercise'
user_sees: Screen 'Add exercise' with the exercise list, a Create button and Close
must_not: An empty list when exercises exist

steps.action: Tap one exercise
user_sees: Back on 'Edit routine' with the exercise added at the end
must_not: The exercise added twice by a double tap
Going back past the editor

steps.action: Type a name not in the list and tap Create
user_sees: The new exercise form with the typed name filled in
must_not: Two forms opened

start: A gym member on 'Edit routine', menu open ('More for this routine')

steps.action: Tap 'Duplicate routine'
user_sees: 'Where should the copy go?' with the folders
must_not: A copy made without asking where

steps.action: Tap 'Move to folder' with only one folder
user_sees: 'No other folder' - 'Make a folder on the Workout tab first.'
must_not: An empty picker

steps.action: Tap 'Share routine'
user_sees: The share sheet for the routine
must_not: Workout history or body weight in the shared routine

start: A gym member editing a routine when things go wrong

steps.action: Change a set count while the save fails
user_sees: 'Couldn't save your last change. It is still shown here.' and 'Try again'
must_not: The change shown as saved when it was not

steps.action: Clear the routine name and press back
user_sees: The old name kept
must_not: A routine saved with an empty name

steps.action: Open a routine link for a routine that no longer exists
user_sees: 'Routine not found' - 'This routine may have been deleted.'
must_not: A crash or an endless loading block

steps.action: Open the preview of a routine with no exercises
user_sees: 'No exercises yet' - 'Edit the routine to add exercises.' and 'Start routine' greyed out
must_not: An empty workout started

steps.action: Tap 'Skip' in the guide after ticking exercises
user_sees: 'Leave without saving?' - 'Your routine is not saved yet. You can still make one any time with New routine.' with 'Leave' and 'Keep going'
must_not: Leaving without asking when exercises are ticked

start: A gym member with a routine 'Push Day'

steps.action: Rename it to 'Push A' and leave by the phone's back
user_sees: 'Push A' on the Workout tab
must_not: The rename lost because Close was not tapped

steps.action: Open 'Edit routine', menu, 'Delete routine'
user_sees: 'Delete routine?' - 'This removes the routine and its exercise list. History is unaffected.' with 'Delete'
must_not: Deleting without asking
Past workouts from this routine deleted

steps.action: Tap 'Delete'
user_sees: Back on the Workout tab, routine gone
must_not: The routine still listed
'Delete failed' when it was deleted

steps.action: Open the guide, go back from step 1
user_sees: The Workout tab, card still there for next time
must_not: The card gone for good without 'Skip'

steps.action: Open the guide, tap 'Skip' with nothing ticked
user_sees: The Workout tab, card gone for good
must_not: The card coming back

start: A gym member signed in to a MettleUp account, sharing workouts with trainers on

steps.action: Make and edit routines
user_sees: Routines stay free
must_not: A lock or paywall on routines

steps.action: Share a routine
user_sees: Only the routine's exercises and sets in what is shared
must_not: Body weight, photos, notes or the phone number shared
